---
name: Mathematical investigation
about: Investigate a conjecture, obstruction, or missing lemma
---

## Mathematical intent and sources
State the question, context, hypotheses, and relevant source locations.

## Acceptance criteria
Describe useful evidence, such as a checked lemma, counterexample, or documented obstruction. Specify any verification and integrity checks.

## Dependencies and prior reports
Link earlier attempts and related results. Describe what has changed since any prior failure.

## Permitted scope
Specify methods, files, and dependencies in scope. Identify changes requiring human approval.

## Budget and stopping conditions
Bound the investigation. State when to escalate and what evidence to preserve if no PR results.
